title: Add HTML table and summary report generators to Rust report library
description: A Rust report-generation library has aggregation helpers (sum, max, min). Add two functions that generate HTML strings: a data table and a summary card.

task_spec.prompt:
The Rust library in src/lib.rs has Item struct and sum/max_item/min_item helpers. Add two HTML-generation functions: 1. pub fn to_html_table(items: &[Item], title: &str) -> String Returns a complete HTML snippet with: - An

containing title - A with a header row () - One row per item - An empty table with just the header if items is empty 2. pub fn to_html_summary(items: &[Item]) -> String Returns an HTML
containing: -

Total: {sum}

where sum is sum(items) formatted to 2 decimal places -

Max: {name} ({value:.2})

— or

Max: N/A

if empty -

Min: {name} ({value:.2})

— or

Min: N/A

if empty Add 2 tests per function (4 total). All 4 existing tests must still pass. cargo test must show 8 tests passing. cargo build must succeed.
NameValue
namevalue
success_criteria: HTML output contains correct tags and data
Empty items handled gracefully in both functions
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `cargo test` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
